description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Persistent Constrictor.
When Persistent Constrictor dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Persistent Constrictor enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Persistent Constrictor.
When Persistent Constrictor dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Persistent Constrictor enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat.
